text:
Anna (PM): Quick sync — inbound from a mid-market customer asking for a 'micro-commit' tier. They want a small reserved monthly commit (cheap), automatic surge credits for spikes, and an optional priority-routing add-on. Curious about feasibility + launch gating.
Mike (Revenue Ops): Love the idea — lower commitment to get them started. Need thinking on how surge credits reconcile with usage-based billing and invoice visibility. Also contract wording for soft vs hard caps.
Olivia (Sales): Two prospects asked for exactly this last week. They want predictable baseline cost but don't want to be throttled during marketing spikes. Willing to pay for priority routing.
Jess (Eng): From infra side we can do token-based quotas + a burst bucket. Enforcement isn't hard but we need clear semantics: bursts allowed up to X% of baseline within time window before falling back to best-effort.
Tobias (Infra): Implementation notes: quota service can support a "surge_bucket" per customer. Need accounting in billing pipeline for consumed surge credits vs paid commit. Also rate-limit fallback policies must be plumbed into routing.
Anna (PM): Proposed launch criteria: 1) Billing supports surge accounting + clear invoice line items, 2) Quota enforcement + priority routing implemented behind feature flag, 3) 3 pilot customers, 4) docs + console UX for commit visualization. Thoughts?
Mike (Revenue Ops): Add: pricing model needs simulation for worst-case unit economics. I'll run scenarios: commit size x surge multiplier x expected spike frequency. Also need an overage clause: either soft (grace credits) or hard (throttle) — legal input required.
Jess (Eng): Tech checklist: API for commit sku creation, server-side feature flag, telemetry to surface queueing/latency and priority routing hit rate. Minimal public API shape we can expose now:
```
commit_tier: {
  monthly_tokens: 50000000,
  surge_multiplier: 2.0,
  priority_addon: true/false
}
```
This is a prototype schema.
Tobias (Infra): Ops checklist: enforce per-tenant surge counter, emit metrics: surge_used, surge_remaining, throttled_seconds. Need a migration plan for existing customers if they enroll.
Olivia (Sales): I'd like a pilot pack: one low-commit startup (for PR), two mid-market with predictable marketing windows. Will recruit. Need a simple FAQ for sales to explain how surge credits work.
Anna (PM): Risks: 1) customers gaming surge to avoid paying, 2) complexity in billing + disputes, 3) QoS promises may be hard during cross-region outages. Mitigations: require minimum monthly commit for QoS guarantee, set hard caps on auto-surge, quick revert to best-effort.
Mike (Revenue Ops): Contract constraints: add a clause that surge credits expire monthly and are billed as overage when exceeded. For priority-routing SLA, require explicit add-on in contract. I'll draft legal-friendly language.
Anna (PM): Action items: Olivia -> recruit pilots (owner: Olivia). Mike -> pricing sims + contract draft (owner: Mike). Jess -> API + telemetry spike plan (owner: Jess). Tobias -> infra quota + metrics ETA (owner: Tobias). I'll draft spec doc and canary plan by EOW.
deploy-bot: feature flag created: feature/microcommit-tier (flag id: ff_microcommit_2387654321)
Anna (PM): OK — syncing with Eng tomorrow 10am PT to review API surface and rollout. If everyone is good, I'll create a short RFC and mark as "pilot ready" once Mike confirms pricing model. :thumbsup:
